title: Renminbi-denominated oil-price movements and inflation dynamics across China's price system
description: Replication data and code for the October 2026 analysis. Contains the historical and October data inputs, analysis-ready monthly data, model and sensitivity code, and numerical results. The macroeconomic sample covers January 1998 to October 2026 and the customs sample covers January 2015 to October 2026. The license label describes a mixed archive. MIT applies to author software and CC BY 4.0 to author-generated statistical results. Third-party data retain their original attribution and applicable provider terms.
